about_the_game:
Aerial Aces is a multiplayer arena shooter with an emphasis on fast movement and large open maps. Face off against other players on expansive maps, utilizing an arsenal of diverse weapons and movement abilities. The aesthetic style of Aerial Aces is based on the abstract and otherworldly style of 90's computer graphics. Low poly environments, contrasting textures, and abstract shapes and terrain.

Aerial Aces has a movement system that is easy to learn, but challenging to master. Your diverse move-set lets you maneuver through the widely varied terrain of each map with ease. Sprint and slide across the ground, propel yourself through water, rocket into the sky, and glide around obstacles to out maneuver your opponents in online deathmatch.

Choose from an arsenal of weapons best suited to your preferred play style. Be it long range encounters at a slower pace with the auto cannon, or up close and frenetic combat with the rotary gun. Make tactical use of explosive weapons like the rocket launcher and grenade launcher, or double your ammunition by duel wielding the same weapon!

Key Features

  • 8 unique deathmatch maps

  • 1 Close quarters target practice map

  • 4 weapons to mix and match

  • Complex movement system

  • Online multiplayer

content_descriptors.notes: The depictions of violence in Aerial Aces involve shooting at other players online using somewhat realistic weapons. But these depictions do not contain blood or gore.
